description: This file defines the PHP class SugarRestRSS, which implements a REST protocol for generating RSS feeds within the SuiteCRM / SugarCRM framework. It extends the SugarRest class and provides methods to generate RSS responses, including header, items, and footer, based on input data. The class handles serialization of data into RSS XML format and manages fault responses for invalid input.

classes.name: SugarRestRSS
classes.description: A class implementing the REST protocol for RSS feed generation, extending SugarRest, with methods for creating RSS responses, handling errors, and formatting RSS XML.

methods.name: generateResponse
methods.description: Serializes input data into RSS XML format, outputting the RSS feed or an error if 'entry_list' is missing.

methods.name: generateResponseHeader
methods.description: Outputs the beginning part of the RSS XML, including channel info and metadata.

methods.name: generateItems
methods.description: Iterates over 'entry_list' and generates individual RSS <item> entries.

methods.name: generateItem
methods.description: Creates a single RSS <item> element based on the provided data, including title, link, description, pubDate, and guid.

methods.name: generateResponseFooter
methods.description: Outputs the closing tags for the RSS XML.

methods.name: serve
methods.description: Returns a fault response indicating invalid RSS input type.

methods.name: fault
methods.description: Outputs an error message within an RSS response, logs the error.
